finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.assumptions: The function `get_line` reads from standard input without checking if the input exceeds `max` characters, which could lead to a buffer overflow if the input is larger than the allocated buffer size.

parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked the loop guard on line 9 which ensures i < max-1 before any assignment to line[i]. Determined that the newline handling on lines 13-15 can only execute when c == '\n', which cannot happen when i == max-1 because the loop exits before reading the newline character. Therefore the subsequent line[i] = '\0' on line 18 writes to a valid index (i == max-1) and no overflow occurs. No other code paths bypass the bounds check. No constant argument or unreachable code changes this conclusion.
